svg.title: Ten chain tasks at four tool counts, with and without LLMToolSelectorMiddleware
svg.desc: A grid of the ten chain tasks for each model, tool count and selector setting, create_agent on the Mac and Claude Haiku 5.5 through the API. A blue or plum square is a pass, a solid rose square a call to a distractor or no call to the needed lookup, a light rose square another failure, and a black square a run that raised. Without the selector Haiku passed 10 of 10 at 5, 20, 50 and 100 tools, and with it 10, 10, 10, 9. Qwen3 4B passed 5, 6, 5, 5 without it and 1, 1, 1, 1 with it. Qwen3 8B ran 5 and 50 tools only. Passes are lenient passes.
svg.text: wrong tool: a distractor, or no item lookup
The number after each group counts the passes of 10. Tools: 5 lookups, distractors, and submit_answer.
selector + list: our own system prompt that adds each tool name and description.
